description: SC7 ①腿豁免清单 (tech-design §Testing Strategy): upstream web e2e cases that do NOT run must be declared here with a reason; the runner (scripts/run-upstream-web-e2e.mjs) fails on any undeclared skip and flags stale entries. 不允许静默跳过. Entry shape: { "test": "<file> > <suite> > <case>", "reason": "..." } — e.g. real-API cases that self-skip without provider credentials in keyless CI get declared here on the first CI run (task 6.3 tunes the credential preflight).
